title: Continuous Open Shell And Sixteen Packet Weighted Vest
description: One independently authored complete empty weighted-training-vest-inspired static exterior. One continuous finite-thickness hollow garment shell joins the lower torso to an integral shoulder yoke, with a true top neck opening, two bounded full side arm openings and an open lower waist. This is a single genus-three material shell, not separate armour plates and connecting strips. Sixteen complete closed curved packet exteriors in two rows on the front and back follow the shell contour and have embedded finite root regions; their seam-coloured top faces are actual facets, not texture. No inner weights, removable inserts, open pockets, buckles or fastening mechanism are claimed. Four constant opaque PBR roles, metre-style native Z up and full annular lower-hem ground datum. All numerical surface domains, aperture topology and pouch geometry are new; no camera-harness fragments, old cuirass plate grids, support arm or fasteners are imported, removed or recoloured. One original model zero scenes, all repeated packet exteriors belong to the one complete vest. No person, mannequin, body fill or external stand. Static illustrative appearance only: no real weight, wearable fit, fastening, fabric behaviour, exercise instructions, training effect, ergonomics, movement, load, impact protection, manufacturing or safety capability. No text, logos, textures, rigging, animation or interaction.
